report.headline: The pelacarsen Phase 3 Lp(a)HORIZON trial failed to meet its primary cardiovascular endpoint, consistent with an underpowered design expecting only a 12.3% relative risk reduction (HR 0.877) at 54.1% power.
report.summary: The trial randomized 8,323 patients with established cardiovascular disease and Lp(a) ≥70 mg/dL to pelacarsen or placebo, targeting 993 primary endpoint events. The top-line readout states the trial did not meet its primary endpoint of reducing cardiovascular events. The calculator predicted narrow success with an expected HR of 0.877 (12.3% RRR) and only 54.1% power, below the conventional 80% threshold; the minimum detectable HR at 80% power was 0.837. Phase 2 data showed -67% Lp(a) reduction and -19% LDL-C reduction, but no verified phase 3 on-treatment Lp(a) reduction was reported. Strong genetic evidence supports Lp(a) causality (Open Targets score 0.922; variant ORs 1.38-3.67), so failure most likely reflects an effect too small to detect rather than lack of target validity.
key_evidence: 8,323 patients randomized (Readout text supplied by the user; ClinicalTrials.gov NCT04023552 Lp(a)HORIZON; Design and Rationale of Lp(a)HORIZON Trial: Assessing the Effect of Lipoprotein(a) Lowering With Pelacarsen on Major Cardiovascular Events in Patients With CVD and Elevated Lp(a).)

report.what_would_change_this: The observed hazard ratio and confidence interval from the full trial publication, plus phase 3 on-treatment Lp(a) reduction at 80 mg and actual mean baseline Lp(a) in the randomized cohort, would confirm whether the effect was truly too small or the trial underpowered.
report.readthrough_note: Olpasiran, an LPA-targeting siRNA in Phase 3 (NCT07136012, 11,000 patients, primary completion 2031), achieved 71-97% Lp(a) reduction in Phase 1 and may test whether larger Lp(a) lowering translates to cardiovascular benefit.

mechanism.target_genetics_rationale: LPA genetic association score 0.922 with 183 evidence items; multiple coronary artery disease studies (GCST010479, FINNGEN_R12_I9_UAP, GCST90436075, GCST008370, GCST90013864) all published before cut-off; reference table confirms Lp(a) causal=yes.
mechanism.notes: Lp(a) reduction: phase 2 placebo-adjusted -67% (f_6277dd5a7799df, 20-80 mg monthly range) used as proxy for phase 3 80 mg monthly dose; no verified phase 2 data at exact 80 mg dose. FRONTIERS APHERESIS phase 3 (80 mg) showed -72% (f_41e180cd554aed) but in apheresis population. LDL-C: phase 2 absolute change -8.0 mg/dL (-0.207 mmol/L) and percent change -19% from same source (pmid:35300814); multiple conflicting values reported in that paper. apoB: phase 2 -16% (f_0da429d37235b6). Baseline Lp(a): HORIZON inclusion threshold 70 mg/dL overall (f_1db6503f0913df), 90 mg/dL subpopulation (f_735ab4b2f932a3); mean baseline not reported. followup_years=3.25 is midpoint of minimum 2.5y (f_aa53dba69890b4, stated as 'minimum follow-up required') and planned ~4y (f_f3e17a33d78737, protocol timeFrame); actual median follow-up unknown. Events: 993 planned (f_4ab7bce48e2dae); actual events not in verified facts despite trial readout. No SBP, observed HR/CI, or phase 3 lipid changes in verified facts.

issues.issue: Calculator uses Lp(a) pct_change -67% (upper end of phase 2 20-80 mg range) as proxy for phase 3 80 mg dose. The phase 2 data (f_6277dd5a7799df) shows dose-dependent decreases from -29% to -67%. Using the maximum reduction may overestimate the expected effect at 80 mg. The method field acknowledges this as a proxy.
issues.request: Verify if phase 2 dose-response data at 80 mg specifically exists for Lp(a) reduction. If only range is available, consider using a more conservative estimate (e.g., midpoint) or explicitly model the uncertainty.

issues.issue: Calculator uses LDL-C pct_change -19% (upper end of phase 2 range) and apoB -16% (upper end). The phase 2 data shows ranges: LDL-C -2% to -19% (f_4b4e03d46ecbee), apoB -3% to -16% (f_0da429d37235b6, f_5e6844c1422f2d). Using upper bounds may overestimate benefit.
issues.request: Check if dose-specific LDL-C/apoB changes at 80 mg are available in phase 2 data. If only ranges, consider using midpoint or lower bound for conservative estimate.

issues.issue: Calculator uses Lp(a) baseline 70 mg/dL (inclusion threshold) but actual mean baseline in randomized cohort is unknown. Phase 2 baseline was ~12-16 mg/dL (f_7ca3967915c765, f_ee94d4795ac3e4), very different population. The absolute Lp(a) reduction depends on baseline; using threshold as baseline is a proxy that may misestimate absolute change.
issues.request: Search for actual mean baseline Lp(a) in Lp(a)HORIZON randomized cohort. If unavailable, document the uncertainty and consider sensitivity analysis with plausible range (e.g., 70-150 mg/dL).

issues.request: Remove or clarify the reference to Lp(a)FRONTIERS APHERESIS injection site reactions in the off_target_harm hypothesis for Lp(a)HORIZON. Search for Lp(a)HORIZON-specific safety data.

issues.issue: Verified fact f_aa53dba69890b4 is labeled 'median_followup' but Verifier found it states 'minimum follow-up is required to be 2.5 years' not median. The calculator correctly uses midpoint (3.25 years) per instructions, but the fact labeling is inaccurate.
issues.request: Correct the fact label for f_aa53dba69890b4 from 'median_followup' to 'minimum_followup' or add a clarifying note.
